user.title: Connect to iSolarCloud
user.description:
Enter your iSolarCloud API credentials. You can find them here: [iSolarCloud]({url})

After you submit, the hub is created and Home Assistant will prompt you to authorize it in your browser.

data_description.app_id: App ID from iSolarCloud Developer Platform. To find this, go to your application and look for 'id' within the URL like so: {app_id_url}.

auth_callback.title: Waiting for authorization
auth_callback.description:
Open the link below to authorize the application:

{auth_url}

After you log in and approve the app, you will be redirected back and this screen will update automatically.

If the redirect does not complete (for example the page shows an error), wait a moment and you will be able to paste the code manually.

auth_manual.title: Enter Authorization Code
auth_manual.description:
The automatic redirect did not complete. Finish authorizing manually:

{auth_url}

**Instructions:**
1. Visit the link above and log in (skip if you already did).
2. You will be redirected (the page may show an error).
3. Copy the **code** parameter from the URL address bar.
4. Paste the code — or the full redirect URL — below.

data.code: Authorization Code or full redirect URL

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure iSolarCloud
reconfigure.description: Update your region or API credentials (the App ID stays the same). You'll be asked to authorize again in your browser, since new credentials or a new region require fresh tokens.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Set up local Sungrow inverter
zeroconf_confirm.description: A Sungrow **{model}** was discovered on your network at **{host}** (WiNet-S). Set it up to read data directly over local Modbus — fast, unmetered and offline-capable, with no iSolarCloud account required.

error.invalid_extra_measure_points: Extra measure points must be in the form point_id=code, comma separated

abort.library_missing: The pysolarcloud library is not installed. Restart Home Assistant so the integration's requirements are installed, then try again.
abort.missing_code: Authorization code was not received. Please try again.
abort.wrong_account: The authorized account does not match this integration's App ID. Use the original developer application.
abort.not_sungrow_device: The discovered device is not a supported Sungrow inverter.

init.title: Sungrow Options
init.description: Adjust how often Home Assistant polls iSolarCloud. Lower values update more frequently but use more of your API quota. The free plan allows ~2000 calls/hour; the minimum is 10 seconds.

data.enable_device_sensors: Create per-device sensors (EV chargers, meters, extra batteries)
data.modbus_host: Local Modbus host (WiNet-S IP) — optional; leave blank for cloud only

whitelist_rejection.title: iSolarCloud rejected the request (whitelist)
whitelist_rejection.description: iSolarCloud is rejecting API requests for **{plant}** because this client's IP address or your account is not in your API application's whitelist (E918/E919). Add them in the iSolarCloud Developer Portal (or disable the whitelist); the integration recovers automatically once accepted.

rate_limited.title: iSolarCloud API rate limit reached
rate_limited.description: iSolarCloud is rejecting requests for **{plant}** because the API call limit was reached (E998/E999). Increase the polling interval in the integration options to make fewer calls; it recovers when the quota resets.

dispatch_write_failed.message: Failed to update {param} on the inverter: {error}
